items.topic: EVL does not emit 'must bind itself' for derived members
items.claim: EVL emits 'must bind itself' for derived-member self-binding
items.fact: EVL does not emit that; reproduced via create -> validate --strict -> discard probe against a control that did fail. The self-binding convention stands on its own merits, not on a validator.

Generator scans two equivalent fragment-file layouts (project may mix): Layout A sibling: application/karaf-features/src/main/feature/feature.xml.<slot>.fragment.hbs and application/<module>/pom.xml.<slot>.fragment.hbs; second layout also supported. Slots: feature.xml: extra-repositories, extra-bundles, model-bundles; each pom.xml: project-definition, properties-definition, extra-plugin-management, extra-plugins, extra-dependencies; app-root pom: extra-modules. Slot names come from '<!-- To define create ...fragment.hbs file -->' markers. Analyzer should glob *.fragment.hbs.

items.topic: CI release versioning for blueprint catalog
items.fact: Operator wants a CI releasing a version referenceable in kb search (kind git source pin) for feature branches, and the main project versioned too, using JUDO's feature-branch-name-in-version scheme. Scheme from judo-ng (judo-maven-plugin build.yml / create-release-on-master.yml): develop/feature builds => <base>.<yyyyMMdd_HHmmss>_<shortSha>_<branch with # / . - -> _>; master => plain <base>; tag v<version>; pom uses <revision> (e.g. 1.0.1-SNAPSHOT). Consumer pin example {kind:git, ref:git@github.com:BlackBeltTechnology/judo-blueprint.git, pin:v1.0.0.20260811_101500_ab12cd3_feature_JNG_6380_cli_guidance}. judo-ng/versioning-policy.adoc: GitFlow; don't change version on feature/ or bugfix/ branches; develop 2nd number bumps at release branch start; support/hotfix bump 3rd number.

items.topic: kb frontmatter parser limits and searchable keys
items.fact: pi kb frontmatter parser cannot read '|' or '>' block scalars or anchors/aliases: write description on a single line. Default searchable keys: title, description, aliases, keywords (DEFAULT_SEARCHABLE_KEYS); score is not searchable. Tags become has_tag graph edges; status is a default facet key. Chunker is heading based and fence-safe (mermaid fences safe), parses [[wikilinks]] and md links into graph. kb dox AGENTS.md uses a file/Purpose table. kb_search tool does not expose numeric filters although engine supports gte/lte.

items.topic: Catalog score formula and why it is weak
items.claim: Catalog entries carry 'score' computed from usage
items.fact: score = 0.6*projectWeight(max PROJECTS.md weight -10..10 ->0..100) + 0.2*usage (usage_count minus 0.2*alternative_count, min-max normalised) + 0.2*recency; rank-model-blueprints.py ranks by usage_count only. Score distribution: bp-model n=71 (median 61), backend 74 (67), frontend 62 of 77 scored (41), blueprints 73 of 105 scored; 81 of 105 blueprints seen in a single project. Only query-catalog.py list read scores; kb ignored them. Min-max normalisation makes scores unstable across releases.

items.topic: Drop stored scores, keep computed-from inputs
items.fact: Operator: "Do we really need scores? the information we compute from is better, no?" and "don't drop anything". Outcome: no score field; keep projects, usage_count, first_seen, last_updated, alternatives (as [[wikilinks]]), optional fixed-threshold status tier (single-project/emerging/established) and per-project evidence; project preference stays in PROJECTS.md weights; scoring scripts archived, not deleted; CLI recipes moved to non-indexed legacy/cli-recipes/, not deleted.

items.topic: judo-cli.jar committed to git despite gitignore and pom download
items.claim: .claude/judo-cli.jar is downloaded by pom profile download-model-cli
items.fact: The jar is committed (initial commit 3a342af 98.2MB, replaced in 496fe4a 99.0MB); .gitignore has no effect on tracked files. Pack 88.6MiB, near GitHub 100MB limit; every kb git clone downloads it. pom profile download-model-cli fetches hu.blackbelt.judo.runtime:judo-model-cli:${judo-model-cli-version}=1.1.0.20260126_071613_e7eac4ad_develop classifier standalone from https://nexus.judo.technology/repository/maven-judong (needs JUDONG_NEXUS_* creds), auto-activates when file is missing. Local jar reports --version 1.0.0 (Main-Class hu.blackbelt.judo.cli.JudoModelClient), so maven copy likely does not overwrite and CI probably runs the committed jar (inferred, unverified). Fix: git rm --cached, rely on pom profile, bump version; optional history purge (force-push, team decision).
